name: pivot_two_value_columns_by_index
query: SELECT year, root(account, 2) AS category, count(*) AS n, sum(number) AS total WHERE account ~ '^Expenses:(Food|Home|Transport)' GROUP BY 1, 2 PIVOT BY 1, 2
notes: With several other targets each value gets one column per target, named '<value>/<target>'. Columns may be given by their 1-based index.
